name: Druid
summary: A guardian of the natural order who wields primal magic and takes the shape of beasts.
flavor: Druids revere nature above all, gaining their spells and other magical powers either from the force of nature itself or from a nature deity. Many druids pursue a mystic spirituality of transcendent union with nature, and all of them share an understanding that the natural world is a delicate balance that must be preserved — sometimes gently, sometimes with tooth and claw.

multiclassing.spellcastingNote: Add your full druid level when determining shared multiclass spell slots.

spellcasting.focus: A druidic focus (sprig of mistletoe, totem, wooden staff, yew wand)
spellcasting.notes: Druids will not wear armor or use shields made of metal — a taboo of the order rather than a mechanical restriction.

features.name: Druidic
features.description: You know Druidic, the secret language of druids. You can speak it and use it to leave hidden messages: you and others who know the language automatically spot such a message, and others spot its presence only with a successful DC 15 Perception check — though they can't decipher it without magic.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Drawing on the divine essence of nature itself, you can cast spells to shape that essence to your will. You know two cantrips and prepare a number of druid spells each day equal to your Wisdom modifier + your druid level. You can cast any prepared druid spell with the ritual tag as a ritual, and you use a druidic focus as a spellcasting focus.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.description:
As an action, you can magically assume the shape of a beast you have seen before. You can use this feature twice, regaining expended uses on a short or long rest.

| Level | Max CR | Limitations |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 2nd | 1/4 | No flying or swimming speed |
| 4th | 1/2 | No flying speed |
| 8th | 1 | — |

You can stay in beast form for a number of hours equal to half your druid level (rounded down), then revert unless you spend another use. You revert automatically if you fall unconscious, drop to 0 hit points, or die.

While transformed: you use the beast's statistics but keep your alignment, personality, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; you retain your skill and saving throw proficiencies plus the beast's; you can't cast spells (though your concentration continues); and your equipment merges into the new form or falls to the ground, your choice.

features.name: Druid Circle
features.description: Choose a circle that shapes your practice of druidcraft. It grants features at 2nd, 6th, 10th, and 14th level.

features.name: Wild Companion
features.description: You can expend a use of Wild Shape to cast *find familiar* without material components. The familiar is a fey rather than a beast, and it disappears after a number of hours equal to half your druid level.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20. Gained again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level.

features.name: Cantrip Versatility
features.description: Whenever you gain an Ability Score Improvement, you can replace one druid cantrip you know with another druid cantrip.

features.name: Timeless Body
features.description: Primal magic sustains you. For every 10 years that pass, your body ages only 1 year.

features.name: Beast Spells
features.description: You can cast many of your druid spells in any shape you assume using Wild Shape. You can perform the somatic and verbal components of a druid spell while in beast form, but you can't provide material components.

features.name: Archdruid
features.description: You can use Wild Shape an unlimited number of times. Additionally, you can ignore the verbal and somatic components of your druid spells, as well as any material components that lack a cost and aren't consumed by the spell — in any form.
